items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Canada URL: https://designfiles.co/ About the job: We're looking for a highly organized Content Marketing Coordinator to join our team on a remote contract basis. This role is ideal for someone who loves turning ideas into finished marketing campaigns. You'll write content, coordinate creative assets, keep projects moving, and make sure every email, social post, landing page, and product announcement is polished before it reaches our audience. We're not looking for flashy marketing copy. We're looking for someone who can communicate like a real human, who can write the way you'd talk to a designer over coffee: helpful, clear, and genuinely useful. If you're someone who notices the small details, enjoys keeping projects organized, and gets satisfaction from shipping great work, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll help with: You'll work closely with our marketing and product teams to help bring campaigns to life by: Writing and editing marketing emails, newsletters, social posts, ads, landing pages, product updates, and promotional copy Turning campaign ideas, product launches, and feature updates into clear action plans, timelines, and deliverables Coordinating with designers to create graphics, creative assets, and revisions Gathering screenshots, product details, customer examples, links, and supporting materials needed for marketing projects Scheduling and publishing emails, social content, and other marketing updates Helping execute product launches, webinars, contests, promotions, and campaigns Reviewing marketing assets before they go live to ensure quality and accuracy Keeping marketing calendars, task lists, and project documentation organized and up to date Following up with team members to keep projects moving and deadlines on track What you’ll need: Excellent writing and editing skills Able to write marketing that feels like a helpful one-on-one conversation, not generic sales copy Strong understanding of audience, tone, and clear communication Exceptional organization and attention to detail (this is one of the most important parts of the role) Comfortable managing multiple projects at once without losing track of details Reliable follow-through and a bias toward getting things done Experience with email marketing, social media, content marketing, or campaign execution Bonus points: Experience working with SaaS companies Experience in the interior design industry or another creative field About us: DesignFiles is an all-in-one business platform built specifically for interior designers. Thousands of designers use DesignFiles to manage projects, collaborate with clients, create presentations, source products, and run more profitable businesses. Everything we create is designed to make designers' lives easier, and our marketing reflects that. We focus on education, practical advice, and helping designers succeed—not pushy sales tactics. Apply for the job: Love writing clear, helpful content and keeping marketing projects moving? Join DesignFiles as a remote Content Marketing Coordinator. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Macedonia / Georgia / Moldova / Romania / Greece / Croatia / Kosovo / Serbia URL: http://belkins.io In 2017, Belkins started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. For seven years running, we’ve been the top appointment-setting agency, achieving amazing results across 50+ industries worldwide. Our results speak for themselves: with over 1,000 clients and a global portfolio, we’ve set up more than 200,000 appointments, delivering a $10 return for every $1 spent. We’re experts in B2B appointment setting, providing essential services for companies ready to take their growth to the next level. By diving deep into lead research and using customized, omnichannel strategies, we turn opportunities into real success. Joining Belkins means signing up for a journey of unstoppable growth and success, driven by curiosity, dedication, and a commitment to excellence. We are looking for a results-driven SDR to join our intake pod - the team that runs new clients through their first three months at Belkins. Each pod is built around an Account Strategist who owns client strategy through the pilot, supported by a Delivery Lead, Content Strategist, Researcher, and Email Deliverability Specialist. This structure means the technical side of outreach is handled for you - your focus is on calling and converting prospect responses into booked appointments. You will work across multiple pilot-stage client projects at once (typically 3-4), running high-volume cold calling via power dialer and personally managing all replies from automated email and LinkedIn campaigns. Because every account is brand new, the meetings you book in the first weeks carry extra weight - they're often a client's first real proof that the engagement is working. Things You’ll Be Doing: Cold Calling Running outbound calling campaigns via power dialer (Koncert) across multiple (3-4) pilot-stage client projects at once - every account brand-new, so there's no history to lean on and no slow ramp-up; Handling objections live, on the call, and steering each conversation toward a booked appointment, not just working through a script; Tracking connect rate and call-to-meeting conversion, flagging performance issues to your Account Strategist before they become a pattern - with only three months on the clock, a slow week can't go unnoticed. Reply Handling — Email & LinkedIn Personally owning every reply that comes in from automated email (Reply.io / Inbox AI) and LinkedIn (Expandi) campaigns -responding within 4–8 working hours, handling objections in writing, and nurturing prospects until they convert into confirmed meetings; Scheduling appointments and sharing meeting details with the team via Slack. items.title: Travel Expert | Reviewer
items.summary: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants.
items.description: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants. Your job isn’t to “write itineraries.” It’s to think like a real trip planner and spot what makes a travel situation real, feasible, and decision-changing — then upgrade weak scenarios so they actually test the model. ‼️ AI is not allowed. If we spot AI use, we’ll block the application. ⚠️ This application form must be completed entirely in English. 🚨 READ ALL THE DESCRIPTION BELOW TO UNDERSTAND THE APPLICATION FORM. WHO CAN APPLY Travel professionals and experienced trip planners 3+ years of relevant travel planning experience (professional or high-volume personal) English level: Advanced / Fluent (required) WHAT YOU’LL DO IN THE APPLICATION (QUICK SCREENING TEST) You will review two pre-generated travel tasks . For each task, you’ll answer simple 1–5 ratings and give a short justification. Then, for the 2nd task , you’ll rewrite it to make it stronger . WHAT “STRONG” MEANS (SIMPLE DEFINITION) A strong task includes one decisive feasibility constraint that can flip the plan if ignored (missed train, missed check-in, closed attraction, wrong station, etc.). We call this a Knife : A Knife is a constraint that changes what itinerary is actually viable . Quick test: if you remove it, the “best plan” would meaningfully change. Examples of Knives in Travel Last train / last entry / check-in cutoff times Closures and holidays that change what’s possible Ambiguous locations (airport/station names that can be confused) Sequential dependencies (if A slips, B becomes impossible) Mobility constraints that change routing feasibility WHAT YOU WILL RATE (1–5) IN THE FORM You’ll give 3 ratings per task: Overall Quality (1–5) How clear and testable the task is (can you judge PASS/FAIL)? Knife / Hidden Context Strength (1–5) Is there a decisive feasibility constraint — or is the “hidden context” just extra color that doesn’t change the plan? Checklist Quality (1–5) Does the checklist truly test feasibility + the Knife with clear criteria? (Strong checklists include verification steps and forbid inventing logistics, written as PASS/FAIL — not “be helpful.”) You’ll also write a short justification (2–4 bullets) explaining your ratings. WHAT YOU WILL REWRITE (FOR THE 2ND TASK ONLY) You will rewrite these parts to make the task stronger: Scenario (3rd person) — more realistic + naturally sets up the feasibility risk Prompt (user message) — natural, human, does not reveal the Knife Hidden Context (1–3 bullets) — must include exactly 1 decisive Knife Checklist (4–6 items) — each item must be PASS/FAIL, covering: feasibility/verification (minimum unknowns to check) the Knife (the decision-flipping constraint) no invented logistics (no made-up schedules/hours/availability) branching plan (Plan A / Plan B) when feasibility depends on one missing answer safety only when there is real risk Checklist item example: PASS if it flags what must be verified (tickets/hours/cutoffs) before committing; FAIL if it confidently invents times or availability. Important: Don’t “leak” the Knife in the prompt (no “IMPORTANT”, no all-caps, no “the key detail is…”). IF SELECTED (PROJECT WORK) You’ll review batches of pre-generated travel scenarios: Rating realism and feasibility risk Identifying weak or missing constraints (Knives) Improving tasks so they better represent real travel moments where wrong advice causes missed connections, wasted money, or ruined plans COMPENSATION Payment will be US$ 30 per approved task, converted and paid in your local currency. Each task takes approximately 40 minutes, which corresponds to an effective rate of about US$ 45 per hour. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR You can recognize what’s realistic vs. generic in travel planning You understand what truly flips feasibility (cutoffs, closures, dependencies, ambiguous locations) You can upgrade a “fine” scenario into a strong feasibility test without making it artificial Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Conceptual Copywriter
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Conceptual Copywriter to ideate and execute impactful creative work across digital campaigns and marketing channels. In this role, you’ll partner with designers, strategists, and performance teams to develop concept-driven copy that delivers both creative impact and measurable results. You will work closely with enterprise-level customers helping translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling messaging for global audiences. This role is ideal for a writer who enjoys turning strategic insights into powerful creative ideas while crafting high-performing copy across digital platforms.

items.title: Lead Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)
items.summary: Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it. You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.

items.title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong written English and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and follow SOPs. Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. Nice-to-Have Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience. Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools. Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance. Experience with dashboards and reporting. Experience using AI research and translation tools. Key Qualities Detail-oriented Analytical Investigative Highly organized What We Offer 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines. Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning. Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence. Application Process We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible. The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us. items.description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world. We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work. We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it. About the Role Location: Remote, United States Role-Type: Full-Time, W2 Employee Reports To: Senior Director, AI Programs Compensation: $130,000 to $148,000 per year Start Date: September 21st, ahead of the October 19th cohort launch Together with Anthropic, CodePath launched Claude Corps in June 2026, a national fellowship program with a $150 million commitment to place 1,000 AI-trained fellows at nonprofits across America. The mentorship model works, but we need experienced professionals to coach and guide those mentors, as well as be responsible for the success of our mentor’s performance and our curriculum delivered to the Fellows. A CodePath Mentor coaches about 20 fellows, so a thousand fellows means more than forty mentors, and someone has to own whether all of them actually deliver. That someone is the Senior Manager of AI Practice. You manage a team of mentors and you own the delivery outcome for their fellows: at full scale, about ten mentors and 200 fellows, fewer while the program ramps. You are accountable for whether fellows are actually learning, pod by pod and mentor by mentor. When a mentor's pods stall, when a fellow's work drifts off track, when the same problem shows up across three pods at once, it is yours to catch and yours to fix. Curriculum will be developed, with your influence, at scale, you own the delivery layer: seeing where it lands across your pods and where it doesn't. You keep Commons central to how your mentors and fellows work, and you close the loop back to the curriculum team so the next version is sharper than the last. This is a hands-on, operational role, and it grows with the program. You start by running the first cohort's small mentor team directly and build the delivery systems that let quality hold as the program climbs from 100 fellows to 1,000. A real part of the craft is reading when a lesson should come from a mentor inside a pod and when the whole group needs to hear it from you in real time. It is built for someone who has run delivery for a team before and would rather raise ten people's game than do all the work themselves. Key Responsibilities Manage the mentor team Manage a team of mentors, about ten at full scale and fewer during the ramp: hire, onboard, coach, and hold the bar on the quality of their coaching Run your team's operating cadence: weekly syncs, 1:1s, and the escalation path when a mentor or a fellow needs help Make sure the day-to-day the model depends on actually happens across your team: pull requests reviewed on time, milestone reviews run, host managers engaged Own delivery for your fellows Own the delivery outcome for your portfolio, roughly 200 fellows at full scale: whether instruction lands, not whether mentors look busy Own the agenda-based instructional time for your whole portfolio: set the agenda, and decide each session whether to teach it yourself, live and to everyone at once, or hand it to your mentors to run in their pods. Either way, whether it lands is on you Hold the quality framework for mentorship: what good coaching looks like, how it gets reviewed, and what happens when it misses the bar Own the milestone-review roll-up across your fellows, and step in on the ones whose work is at risk Replace hand-tracking with delivery systems that hold at volume; the model ran on spreadsheets at 100 fellows and won't at 1,000 Own the CodePath-to-Commons layer Partner with the Claude Corps strategic partners as their counterpart in the field: you see what is landing across your mentors and fellows, and you bring it back as structured signal Own how your team uses Commons: the curriculum ships through the platform, and you own whether it is used the way it was designed Turn what you see in the field into curriculum change requests the curriculum team can act on, and close the loop when they ship Key Success Metrics 100% of your mentors are running their weekly cadence on schedule and you can pull that from your dashboard, not from what mentors report in standup You can name where each mentor is strong and where they need help, and your weakest spot has a concrete plan implemented within 30 days You've surfaced your top 3-5 delivery patterns across your fellows to the Claude Corps leadership team, and at least 1 has shipped as a curriculum change You have a single delivery view that shows the state of your portfolio at a glance, in place of whatever was hand-tracked before you Qualifications Required You have managed people and can point to specific ways you raised a team's performance, ideally technical or coaching staff 3-5 years of technical program management, engineering management, or other program management experience where you directly led cross-functional teams to drive measurable outcomes. You don't have to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable working with technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive programmatic success You can hold a room, teaching a live session and keeping it sharp, because some weeks you are the one in front of the group You have owned a delivery or operations outcome at volume, personally on the hook for its quality You have replaced manual, hand-run processes with systems that held up as the work scaled You have shipped real work using AI-assisted development tools and can describe specifically how your workflow changed; you have to hold your mentors and fellows to that bar Strong written communication: feedback, roll-ups, escalations, and change requests, in a remote and mostly asynchronous org Comfortable with remote, synchronous obligations across US time zones and about two evenings a month for cohort sessions and milestone reviews Preferred You have managed coaches, instructors, or other managers in a bootcamp, fellowship, residency, or other cohort-based program You have scaled a delivery team through fast headcount growth without letting quality slip Comfort with a platform- or LMS-delivered learning model, and reading delivery data to find risk before it surfaces Compensation CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring at an annual salary of $130,000 to $148,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process. Full-Time Employee Benefits This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2) Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings Pay range $130,000—$148,000 USD

items.description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. How You’ll Make an Impact: As the Manager, Global Talent Acquisition , you will be responsible for defining and executing Cloudbeds’ global talent acquisition strategy while elevating the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of hiring across the organization. This is far more than a traditional recruiting leadership role. You will serve as a strategic partner to executive leadership, helping shape workforce planning decisions, hiring strategies, talent market positioning, executive recruiting initiatives, hiring governance, and recruiting operations. You will lead a globally distributed Talent Acquisition team while partnering closely with leaders across Customer Success, Onboarding, GTM, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Staff & Corporate functions. This role will directly impact Cloudbeds’ ability to attract exceptional talent, improve quality of hire, strengthen leadership pipelines, and support the company’s next phase of growth. In this role, you will also be responsible for driving recruiting analytics, workforce planning initiatives, hiring process optimization, executive recruiting programs, and talent intelligence efforts globally. You will leverage data and market insights to influence hiring decisions, identify opportunities, and support organizational growth. Given the strategic nature of the role, this position requires strong business acumen, executive presence, operational excellence, and the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization. Our People Team: We’re a globally distributed, multicultural People Team spanning NORAM, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC, and that global footprint isn’t just a fact; it’s a strength we fully embrace. Our team brings together a diverse mix of perspectives, experiences, and expertise that help us build thoughtful, scalable, and people-centered solutions across the organization. We partner closely with leaders at every level to help Cloudbeds grow intentionally, build strong teams, strengthen leadership capability, and create exceptional team member experiences. We believe the People Team should be strategic business partners, not simply administrators. We use data, business insight, operational excellence, and strong relationships to influence decisions and drive outcomes. The Manager, Global Talent Acquisition, reports to the Global Director of People and plays a critical leadership role within the People organization, helping shape the future of hiring at Cloudbeds. What You’ll Bring to the Team: Global Talent Acquisition Strategy Develop, execute, and continuously evolve Cloudbeds’ global Talent Acquisition strategy in alignment with business priorities and long-term organizational growth. Partner with executive leadership to anticipate future hiring needs and translate business objectives into scalable talent acquisition strategies. Build recruiting programs that enable sustainable growth while maintaining a strong focus on hiring quality, speed, and consistency. Continuously evaluate market trends, talent availability, and competitive intelligence to ensure Cloudbeds remains positioned to attract exceptional talent globally. Hiring Excellence & Quality of Hire Champion hiring excellence across the organization by continuously raising the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of hiring decisions. Design and implement structured interviewing frameworks, assessment methodologies, and hiring governance processes that improve long-term hiring success. Partner with leaders to calibrate hiring expectations, strengthen interview practices, and reduce bias throughout the selection process. Establish quality-of-hire metrics and continuously evaluate hiring outcomes to improve recruiting effectiveness and long-term organizational performance. Promote an exceptional candidate experience while maintaining rigorous hiring standards and a high hiring bar. Executive Search & Leadership Hiring Lead executive and senior leadership searches across multiple functions globally. Develop proactive talent mapping strategies and build long-term relationships with high-caliber leadership talent. Partner with executive search firms when appropriate while ensuring an outstanding candidate experience throughout the executive hiring process. Serve as a trusted advisor to executives throughout complex leadership hiring decisions. Workforce Planning & Talent Intelligence Partner closely with Finance, People, and business leaders to develop workforce plans aligned with company growth objectives. Provide data-driven recommendations regarding hiring locations, organizational design, market availability, compensation trends, and talent competitiveness. Leverage recruiting analytics, talent intelligence, and market insights to influence executive decision-making and support long-term business planning. Build executive dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into recruiting performance, talent risks, and future hiring opportunities. Recruiting Operations & Process Excellence Continuously improve recruiting operations, workflows, systems, reporting, and recruiting technology to ensure scalability and operational excellence. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate bottlenecks, and improve efficiency without compromising hiring quality. Ensure recruiting processes remain globally consistent while balancing regional requirements and business needs. Drive operational excellence through clear metrics, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives. Leadership & Team Development Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed Talent Acquisition team. Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, innovation, continuous learning, and accountability. Support career development through regular coaching, feedback, mentoring, and succession planning. Create an environment where recruiters operate as strategic business partners rather than transactional recruiters. Executive Partnership & Business Influence Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to executives and senior leaders across the organization. Influence workforce planning, organizational growth, leadership hiring, and talent strategy through strong business acumen and data-driven recommendations. Challenge hiring assumptions when appropriate, providing thoughtful guidance that balances business needs, talent availability, and long-term organizational success. Build strong cross-functional partnerships that position Talent Acquisition as a trusted business partner and a key driver of organizational growth. What Sets You Up for Success: 8+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition experience. 5+ years of recruiting leadership experience. Significant SaaS or high-growth technology recruiting experience. Strong recruiting expertise, including GTM, Customer Success, Technology, and Revenue organizations. Executive recruiting experience. Experience implementing structured hiring assessments and hiring governance frameworks. Workforce planning and talent intelligence expertise. Experience leading globally distributed recruiting teams. Strong analytical, operational, and strategic planning capabilities. Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive business outcomes. Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth, remote-first environment. Experience with ATS platforms, recruiting analytics, and workforce planning tools. Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken). Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $180 000 and $195 000 USD (t he salary is only for US-based candidates). #LI-PD1 What to Expect - Your Journey with Us Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary. Learn more online at cloudbeds.com Company Awards : Best All-In-One Hotel Management System | HotelTechAwards (2025) Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025) Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024) Top 10 People’s Choice (2024) Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024) Discover our Benefits: Remote First, Remote Always PTO in accordance with local labor requirements Monthly Wellness Fridays - enjoy an extra-long weekend every month Fully Paid Parental Leave Home office stipend based on country of residency Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling and knowledge transfer Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Cloudbeds will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations in the hiring process. We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our HR team by phone at (858) 201-7832 or via email at accommodations@cloudbeds.com . Cloudbeds will provide an American Sign Language (ASL) interpreter where needed as a reasonable accommodation for the hiring processes. To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Cloudbeds. Staffing, recruiting agencies, and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit applications, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Cloudbeds does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Cloudbeds employees, or any other company location. Cloudbeds is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications. #LI-REMOTE

items.description: About Vercel : Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. About the Role: We are looking for a Product Manager to own the Vercel Dashboard, the control plane for every Vercel user, defining how developers and teams interact with Vercel from first login through daily use, across both individual accounts and enterprise organizations. You will lead the shift from what is a project listing page today to a personalized, agent-powered surface that proactively helps users ship and discover value. You will report to the Product Lead and will be located in San Francisco, CA (hybrid). If you're based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. What You Will Do: Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Vercel Dashboard, the primary surface through which all Vercel customers interact with the platform Define how agents operate within the Dashboard, from surfacing errors and suggesting fixes to updating code and config on behalf of users Shift the Dashboard from a passive "pull" experience to a proactive "push" experience, surfacing insights, notifications, and recommended actions Define the information architecture and design patterns that product area teams build within, and partner with those teams (Billing, CI/CD, Observability) to keep their experiences consistent and high-quality within the Dashboard shell Collaborate with Engineering to hold an uncompromising performance bar. The Dashboard must be the fastest, most delightful surface at Vercel Run experiments and measure onboarding funnel performance, feature adoption, and engagement across user segments About You: You've built and shipped developer-facing products You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, cloud, or developer tools companies You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple You think about the product from both a human and an agent perspective. You use AI tools in your own workflow and have a point of view on how agents should interact with product surfaces You have experience running experiments and working with product analytics to drive roadmap decisions Bonus If You: Have worked on platform or horizontal product teams where you set patterns that other teams adopt Have an engineering background or have built software yourself Have worked on onboarding, activation, or growth loops in a product-led growth context Have experience with personalization frameworks or systems that adapt to user segments and lifecycle stages Benefits: Competitive compensation package, including equity. Inclusive Healthcare Package. Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. Flexible Time Off. We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $172,000 - $258,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

items.description: About Us At Simon, we firmly believe business success starts and ends with people. We’re scrappy problem solvers who care deeply about tackling big challenges with disruptive thinking, giving our customers the support they need, and investing in each other’s growth. We all do our best work when we’re surrounded by other friendly top performers who want to succeed together. When you trust your team, give them ownership, and build with heart, great things happen. Simon Data was founded in 2015 by a team of successful serial entrepreneurs. Today, we’re more than a CDP—Simon is a complete solution that empowers marketers with the data, technology, and expert resources they need to stop guessing and start delivering what customers want. Our revolutionary Simon AI puts 100x more data at marketers’ fingertips, helping them uncover their best audiences, launch higher-performing campaigns, and double their output without doubling the workload. That’s why leading brands like ASOS, Mattress Firm, and 1-800-Flowers trust Simon to power sustainable, high-performing customer marketing programs. The Role The marketing status quo isn’t cutting it anymore. Today’s teams need more than dashboards and guesswork — they need real outcomes. Simon Data delivers the industry’s first goal-based AI marketing workflow, translating business objectives directly into high-performing audience segments. Unlike generic AI solutions, our Agents work with your existing data today to deliver real results—no black box, no fluff. We’re scaling fast and rewriting how modern SaaS sales should feel. As an Account Executive at Simon, you won’t just sell — you’ll help define how our product gets positioned, how our pipeline gets built, and how our deals get won. What You’ll Do Own the deal. Drive the full sales cycle from outbound to close — and do it with precision, urgency, and heart. Sell to the C-suite. Build trust with Marketing, Data, and Tech leaders at high-growth brands and enterprise players alike. Make the complex simple. Run clear, value-driven demos and proofs of concept that tie customer goals to Simon’s outcomes. Collaborate like it’s your job (because it is). Work closely with Marketing, Product, and CS to turn insights into action — and wins. Stay sharp. Be a voice of the market, bringing back what you hear to shape messaging, features, and strategy. Hustle smart. Use Gong, Outreach, Salesforce, and whatever else helps you keep deals moving and priorities focused. Who You Are B2B SaaS closer with a track record. You’ve owned and crushed quota, ideally in MarTech, CDP, or data-first SaaS. Consultative seller. You know how to listen, strategize, and tie product features to big-picture business goals. Builder mindset. You love a fast-paced environment where you can shape process, not just follow one. Confident communicator. Whether you’re pitching the CMO or collaborating with an internal stakeholder, you bring clarity and confidence. Curious and coachable. You’re always looking to grow, and you’re open to feedback and iteration. Tool-savvy. You know your way around Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Slack, and whatever else gets the job done. Self-starter with urgency. You don’t wait to be told what to do — you move, you learn, and you make things happen Why You’ll Love Working Here You’ll sell a product you believe in. Our AI delivers real results, fast — and customers love it. You’ll join a team that’s scaling smart. High trust, low ego, and serious about winning together . You’ll grow fast. Personally, professionally, and in your career — with support, feedback, and a path forward. You’ll help shape a category. We’re not just selling software. We’re building the next generation of customer intelligence. You’ll work with people who care. About the work. About the mission. About each other. What We Offer We take care of our team — because when you’re supported, you show up stronger. Here’s a taste of what you can expect: Full health coverage, zero stress. We cover 100% of medical premiums for you and your family. ️ Truly flexible PTO. Take the time you need to recharge, travel, or just log off. No judgment, no red tape. Generous parental leave. Whether you’re growing your family or just need time to adjust, we’ve got you covered — with both maternity and paternity leave that respects your life outside of work. Remote-first perks. Work from anywhere, with quarterly wellness and client support stipends to keep you feeling balanced and equipped. Growth on your terms. Use your annual professional development stipend to level up, learn something new, or invest in the next step of your journey. In compliance with the state and city salary transparency requirements, the potential base salary for this position is from $125,000 to $150,000 which represents a range commensurate with experience. Visa sponsorship for this role is currently not available. Diversity We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, Veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

items.title: Business Operations Manager
items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior PPC Specialist
items.summary: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms.
items.description: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that successful paid media isn't just about launching campaigns; it's about maximizing profitability. You'll be responsible for optimizing the entire acquisition funnel, analyzing campaign performance, improving conversion rates, and making strategic decisions that drive sustainable growth. The ideal candidate is analytical, data-driven, and comfortable balancing campaign execution with performance strategy. Requirements Key Responsibilities Plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other advertising platforms. Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, Conversion Rate, and LTV. Identify profitability issues and optimize the entire conversion funnel. Conduct A/B testing for audiences, creatives, landing pages, and offers. Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights through dashboards and reports. Manage advertising budgets and scale high-performing campaigns. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign results. Implement and maintain tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advertising platforms. Stay up to date with industry trends, AI tools, and platform updates. Requirements Resume in English. Native or near-native English proficiency (spoken and written). 4+ years of experience managing Meta and Google Ads campaigns. Proven experience optimizing campaigns based on ROAS, CPA, CAC, and profitability. Strong understanding of conversion funnels and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards. Experience managing six-figure monthly advertising budgets is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with eCommerce, SaaS, Lead Generation, or Performance Marketing campaigns. Ability to translate data into actionable optimization strategies. By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! items.summary: Work with the bestWe are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. items.description: Software Engineering Surescripts serves the nation through simpler, trusted health intelligence sharing, in order to increase patient safety, lower costs and ensure quality care. We deliver insights at critical points of care for better decisions - from streamlining prior authorizations to delivering comprehensive medication histories to facilitating messages between providers. Job Summary: The Principal Infrastructure Engineer is crucial to ensuring the stability, efficiency and security of the products we operate as crucial components of the nation's healthcare ecosystem. As a member of our Operations team, a Principal Infrastructure Engineer is expected to have knowledge and experience spanning many disciplines with the ability to lead, communicate and execute as a subject matter expert on specific topics or systems. This role may be called upon to troubleshoot deeply technical problems, architect a solution for a new cloud-native application or write an Ansible module to support deployment of new security tooling. At the Principal level, our Platform Engineers are expected to be able to speak on a broad variety of topics and successfully lead projects both internal to our Systems or Operations teams as well as in collaboration with diverse groups of technical and non-technical team members. This position has a specific focus on systems performance tuning and analysis that is becoming even more crucial as we begin operations in Google Cloud Platform. Sizing, tuning troubleshooting and performance monitoring now draw a direct line to the budget as we transition to the minute-by-minute pricing models of the cloud. Knowing where we can gain efficiency and where we cannot sacrifice performance has become a crucial part of our architectural discussion and on-going operational health. Responsibilities: Participate in development of strategic goals and plans for new and existing systems infrastructure. Research, design, architect, and implement new technologies and solutions that span on-premise and cloud platforms in a method consistent with our security policies and infrastructure-as-code principals. Implement performance tuning strategies to optimize system performance, resource utilization, and overall efficiency. Collaborate with other teams to design and implement scalable and resilient infrastructure solutions. Assist in support of issues impacting the performance or reliability of production transactions. Recommend/implement policies, procedures, and technologies to ensure system security through secure system access, monitoring and control. Participate as necessary in routine security evaluations. Implement automation solutions for system provisioning, configuration management, and performance tuning. Ensure compliance with policies, standards, licensing agreements, configuration guidelines, and best-practices for maintaining regulatory compliance. Ensure all systems and processes are well-documented and comply with internal policies and industry standards. Qualifications: Basic Requirements: Bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, information sciences or related field or equivalent experience 8+ years of experience in systems engineering role Experience in a production operation environment with high uptime requirements. Familiarity with configuration management tools (Ansible preferred). Knowledge of virtualization and containerization technologies - Vmware (vSphere / ESXi 8x) and Kubernetes preferred Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Powershell, Python, Perl). Experience with performance, logging and monitoring tools (Zenoss, Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) Strong background in system metrics analysis and monitoring. Experience working in cloud environments (GCP preferred) Preferred Qualifications: Experience operating in an environment with sensitive health data Experience with RedHat, RockyOS and Windows Certifications like RHCE or Google Cloud Architect/Engineer Understanding of network operations, network troubleshooting and the ability to understand the output of packet captures Experience as a Team Lead, or non-people manager leadership role. Surescripts embraces flexibility through its Flexible Hybrid Work model for most positions. This model allows employees to work virtually while still utilizing our offices as collaboration centers. With alignment and agreement from your leadership, you can come and go from the office as needed. To be considered for employment, applicants must have a valid U.S. work authorization allowing work without restrictions with Surecripts in the U.S. At this time, we are unable to provide support or provide sponsorship for immigration benefits such as work visas. Additionally, we do not participate in academic training programs or work-study programs through an academic institution that require employer endorsement of F-1/CPT or F-1/STEM. What You're Like You're relentless in getting stuff done. You apply your expertise in an Agile/DevOps world with other talented people. You're curious about new technology and use your curiosity as fuel to deliver meaningful solutions. And you're into incremental efforts that ultimately reap huge results. What We're Like We're a smart team that loves to work toward a common goal: delivering innovative, industry-leading solutions that improve patient care. We pride ourselves on quality work grounded in transparency and accountability. Our goal is to make a positive impact on healthcare, be it on quality, cost, or patient safety. What the Work is Like Is your thinking cap on? (Do they still make those?) Here, our challenge is to connect disparate, cross-functional skills to create the desired result. We focus on important milestones, work to understand diverse technologies and develop relationships with various groups of people with varied perspectives. Why Wait? Apply Now We're a midsize company. This means you're not just another employee ID number. Here, you can build real relationships and feel supported by truly awesome people with diverse backgrounds and talents in an innovative and collaborative work culture. We strive to create an environment where you can be yourself, share your ideas and work your way. We offer opportunities for employee development, as well as competitive compensation packages and extensive benefits. At Surescripts, base pay is one part of our Total Rewards Package (which may also include bonus, benefits etc.) and is determined within a range. The base pay range for this position is $161,600 - $197,600 per year. Your base pay may vary within or outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including (but not limited to) your qualifications, skills, experience, and location. Benefits include, but are not limited to, comprehensive healthcare (including infertility coverage), generous paid time off including paid childbirth and parental leave and mental health days, pet insurance, and 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting. To learn more, review the Keep You and Yours Healthy , Balancing Work and Life , and Where Talent Takes Shape links under the Better Benefits. Better Work. Better Life section of our careers site. Additionally, this job requires certain mental demands, including the ability to use judgement, withstand moderate amounts of stress and maintain attention to detail with, or without, a reasonable accommodation. items.summary: Qohash is building the zero copy data security control layer, enterprises need to adopt AI safely.
items.description: Qohash is building the zero copy data security control layer, enterprises need to adopt AI safely. Our platform, Qostodian, helps large organizations discover, classify, govern, and remediate sensitive unstructured data across their most critical data sources without moving or copying the data. This zero copy architecture reduces exposure, preserves data sovereignty, and allows enterprises to secure data directly where it lives. This matters because AI adoption is increasing the risk, complexity, and urgency of enterprise data security. Before organizations can safely deploy AI agents, copilots, retrieval systems, or automated workflows, they need to know where sensitive data lives, who and what can access it, and how to enforce controls at scale. Company culture is at our core Our 5 core values are more than just words, they are a way of life for us. We know that companies with a strong culture and a higher purpose perform better in the long run. Do our values speak to you? Pursuit of excellence Resilience Mission focus Accountability Embracing conflict About the team We are standing up a new team for the QSIDS ( Qohash Sensitive Information Detection System) launch, dedicated to the detection engine. A central focus of this team is the integration of embedded AI, machine learning models that run directly on the device and in-system. It is about high-performance, low-resource, on-device inference, embedded into the detection engine itself. The engine is built in Go, with a strong emphasis on performance and minimal resource footprint. Who you are You're a hands-on Go developer who likes living close to the metal - profiling hot paths, trimming allocations, and making concurrent systems behave predictably under load. You enjoy integration work: wiring components, native libraries, and models into a coherent engine, and making the seams disappear. You take pride in owning what you ship, watching how it behaves in production and iterating to keep it fast and reliable. You bring strong engineering fundamentals, write tests as a matter of course, and collaborate naturally, helping the team converge on quality decisions. You're comfortable with the pace and ambiguity of a startup, and you care about the outcome, not just the code. What you will do Design and build a highly efficient cross-platform detection engine for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Integrate embedded machine learning models into the engine for on-device inference, and own the runtime, bindings, and data paths that make them work in-system. Collaborate closely with machine learning and systems colleagues to turn models into production-ready components. Optimize end to end for latency, memory footprint, and CPU — profiling, benchmarking, and tuning both engine code and model execution. Own features all the way to production including instrumenting, monitoring, and iterating to keep them reliable. Collaborate with stakeholders to define milestones and ensure timelines align with development needs. Participate in discussions on technological choices and decisions regarding product development. Resolve anomalies and problems as soon as they arise. Help onboard and train colleagues as the team grows. Communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. items.summary: the opportunity We are looking for a Technical Marketing & MRD Specialist on Smart Sensors & Edge AI to investigate, structure and document the market requirements for next-generation smart sensor applications powered by our Analog Edge AI low-power ASIC.
items.description: the opportunity We are looking for a Technical Marketing & MRD Specialist on Smart Sensors & Edge AI to investigate, structure and document the market requirements for next-generation smart sensor applications powered by our Analog Edge AI low-power ASIC. You bring a solid engineering background that enables you to understand our technology at a deep technical level and translate what you learn into precise, measurable requirements. You combine strong analytical and writing skills with a genuine understanding of technology markets. In this role, you translate market needs, customer problems and application requirements into a structured MRD that guides GEMESYS’s strategy, product, technology and business development activities. You work closely with our management, engineers and business developers to answer critical questions such as: Which smart sensor markets have the strongest need for local or edge AI, meaning on-device learning, inference, event or anomaly detection, or data compression? What problems are customers currently unable to solve efficiently? What sensor capabilities, AI functions and performance levels are required? Which applications benefit most from on-device learning and inference? What are the requirements around power consumption, latency and bandwidth? Which technical requirements are driven by customers, and which by competitors or industry standards? Which product requirements should GEMESYS prioritize for its Edge AI technology? The goal is an MRD that engineering can design against: every requirement quantified, prioritized per segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases. your role Market & Application Research Build a deep understanding of our analog AI hardware, its capabilities and limitations, together with our team. Research the global smart sensor and Edge AI landscape and identify relevant market segments, applications and customer groups. Analyze emerging applications for intelligent and autonomous sensors. Investigate industry trends, technology adoption and customer requirements. Identify high-value use cases where local or edge AI processing provides tangible benefits. Identify opportunities where GEMESYS’s Analog Edge AI architecture creates differentiated value, also beyond sensors. Research competing technologies and alternative solutions, with the support of our engineers. Customer & Stakeholder Requirements Identify and structure customer pain points and unmet needs. Translate qualitative customer requirements into measurable product requirements. Define functional and non-functional requirements for smart sensor systems. Classify these requirements into categories, so that the engineering teams can make trade-offs. Source and conduct customer, expert and partner interviews through your own network, and run the market validation independently. Share your findings with management, and join selected customer and investor meetings where they add value. Market Requirements Document You own the development of a comprehensive MRD, including: Market overview, segmentation and competitive landscape Target applications and use cases Customer personas and stakeholders, where relevant Customer pain points and unmet needs Market and technology trends and their future projections Alternative technology approaches Market and product specification requirements for our Analog Edge AI ASIC: power, energy modes, bandwidth, area, process nodes, target ASP and further parameters, prioritized per segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases Product opportunity areas Recommendations for product and technology development Regulatory and industry considerations Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with GEMESYS’s technical teams to understand the capabilities and limitations of the underlying analog AI hardware. Lead our in-house market analysis team and resources efficiently, so that they support your work and build their own skill set. Translate technical capabilities into customer and application value propositions. Facilitate discussions between technical, commercial and management stakeholders. Challenge our existing assumptions with customer and market evidence. Ensure that product requirements are traceable to actual market needs. Guide future product roadmap decisions. Deliverables You are responsible for producing a professional MRD. Every requirement specified in it is prioritized for each segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases. what you bring Experience in technical marketing, product marketing or application engineering for semiconductors, sensors or embedded systems. Solid understanding of sensor signal chains, low-power electronics and embedded AI, deep enough to discuss architecture trade-offs with chip designers. Extensive experience developing Market Requirements Documents, Product Requirements Documents, market studies or comparable strategic or technical documentation. An established network in smart sensors, Edge AI or semiconductors that gives you direct access to potential customers, domain experts and industry partners, without relying on GEMESYS contacts. Proven ability to independently source, schedule and conduct customer and expert interviews, and to run market validation end to end. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear market and customer requirements. Experience researching technology markets and competitive landscapes. Excellent strategic, analytical and structured thinking skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. Ability to independently conduct research, identify information gaps and develop well-supported conclusions. Domain experience Must have (at least one of the following) Smart sensors Edge AI / TinyML Embedded AI Good to have Analog computing Neuromorphic computing Memristive technology Nice to have Automotive sensing Autonomous systems Wearables or medical devices Originally posted on Himalayas
